title: Spectacle
scene: In a school hallway an uncomfortable student stands in the middle with hands lightly clasped, while five classmates have stopped and turned their attention toward them. Everyone's expression is neutral or concerned, never mocking. One nearby peer is speaking with an overly broad but anatomically natural open-arm gesture, unintentionally drawing everyone's attention to the middle student. Show why unwanted public attention can feel awkward. No pointing, no phones recording, no spotlight or stage, no humiliating details.
alt: A student looks uncomfortable as classmates stop and watch; another student's broad gesture draws unwanted attention to the moment.
